span.p:
Entities are EF Core classes with public properties only:
they declare no methods. Behaviour is in the controllers
and services (diagrams 5 to 8).
Case to client User and to VisaCategory: Restrict.
Optional links (Guid?): SetNull.
The classes hold foreign key ids, no navigation properties;
ApplicationDbContext.OnModelCreating configures the links.
